title: Refresh tokens table schema and migration
description: Define the refresh_tokens table for storing hashed refresh tokens used in JWT-based auth. Each token has an expiry and is linked to a user.
acceptanceCriteria: FK to users.id with cascade delete

steps.details: Create server/src/db/schema/refreshTokens.ts. Define refresh_tokens table: id (uuid pk), user_id (uuid notNull FK → users cascade delete), token_hash (text notNull — bcrypt hash of the actual token), expires_at (timestamp notNull), created_at (timestamp notNull defaultNow()).
Add index on refresh_tokens.user_id for querying/deleting tokens by user (logout all devices).

steps.description: Export types and update schema barrel
steps.details: Export type RefreshToken and type NewRefreshToken. Add 'export * from ./refreshTokens' to schema/index.ts.
Run 'npm run db:migrate'. Verify refresh_tokens table exists with correct schema.

technicalNotes: NEVER store the plaintext refresh token — store bcrypt hash only
On logout, delete all refresh_tokens for the user (or just the one matching the current token)
Periodically clean up expired tokens: DELETE FROM refresh_tokens WHERE expires_at < NOW()
